unlisted_practices: Evaluating diagnostic AI with relative metrics (RPAD/RRAD) that normalize performance against inter-expert disagreement
Using multiple physician opinions rather than a single reference standard
Automated matching of free-form diagnoses instead of selecting from a limited list

screen.reason: The study develops and empirical evaluates a new benchmarking methodology and metrics (RPAD/RRAD) for evaluating LLMs on diagnostic dialogues against panels of physicians, without testing a health system deployment practice or safeguard.
